blocksHtml:
• Description

The Grandstream GWN7603 is a compact enterprise-grade indoor wireless access point designed for small and medium businesses, offices, retail stores, hotels, educational institutions, and branch networks. It delivers reliable dual-band Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac Wave-2) connectivity with advanced MU-MIMO technology for improved performance in high-density wireless environments.


Key Features


  • Dual-Band 802.11ac Wave-2 Wi-Fi Access Point
  • Up to 1.27 Gbps aggregate wireless throughput
  • 2×2:2 MU-MIMO technology with beamforming
  • Supports 100+ concurrent wireless clients
  • Coverage range up to 100 meters
  • 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports
  • 1× Gigabit uplink port with PoE/PoE+ input
  • 2× Gigabit LAN ports with PSE PoE output
  • WPA3 security support
  • Advanced QoS for voice and video applications
  • Embedded controller for centralized AP management
  • Compatible with GWN.Cloud and GWN Manager platforms
  • Wall-mountable compact design
